CommunityPost.title: CommunityPost
CommunityPost.description: Engineering community post for sharing site photos, engineering ideas, field solutions, consultations, and blueprint discussions.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the post author.

authorName.description: Display name of the post author.

title.description: Concise title of the engineering post or question.

body.description: Detailed engineering description, dimensions, or site situation.

category.description: Category of the engineering community post.

location.description: Optional city or site location (e.g. Khartoum, Bahri, Omdurman).

photoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG image encoded as Base64.

visibility.description: Visibility scope of the post; must be PUBLIC for community listing.

likesCount.description: Atomic count of likes on the post.

commentsCount.description: Atomic count of comments/solutions on the post.

solved.description: Whether the consultation or issue has been marked solved by the author.

acceptedCommentId.description: Optional ID of the comment accepted as the best solution.

lastCommentId.description: Optional ID of the last added or removed comment used for atomic batch verification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the post was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the post was last updated (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CommunityComment.title: CommunityComment
CommunityComment.description: A reply, field solution, or engineering review comment attached to a CommunityPost.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the comment author.

authorName.description: Display name of the comment author.

text.description: Engineering reply or proposed solution text.

photoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG attachment encoded as Base64.

visibility.description: Visibility scope matching the parent post.

acceptedSolution.description: True if the parent post author accepted this comment as the verified solution.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the comment was created (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LikedPost.title: LikedPost
LikedPost.description: Per-user marker document tracking whether a user liked a specific community post.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who liked the post.

postId.description: Document ID of the liked community post.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the like was recorded (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CommunityReport.title: CommunityReport
CommunityReport.description: User moderation report submitted against a community post or comment for Google Play UGC safety compliance.

reporterId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reporting user.

targetId.description: Document ID of the reported post or comment.

reportedAuthorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the reported content author.

details.description: Optional extra details from the reporter.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the report was submitted.

/community_posts/{postId}.description: Top-level collection of engineering community posts shared by authenticated users.

/community_posts/{postId}/comments/{comm.description: Subcollection of comments and engineering solutions on a community post.

/community_reports/{reportId}.description: User-submitted moderation reports for community posts and comments.

/users/{userId}/liked_posts/{postId}.description: User-scoped subcollection tracking liked community posts for atomic like/unlike enforcement.
